create_Remotable_subclass: create a subclass of Remotable to expose methods for remote RPC calls
use_remote_method_decorator: use the remote_method decorator to mark a method as callable over RPC
connect_Remote_client: connect a Remote client to a Remotable server and bind remote methods
call_remote_method_sync: call a remote method synchronously via the Remote proxy object
call_remote_method_async: call a remote method asynchronously using the async_ prefix on Remote
